classification.difficultyReason: The source Foundation question requires two supplementary angle possibilities, sketches and corresponding side lengths.

content.prompt: Consider $\triangle PQR$ in which $p=7\text{ cm}$, $q=15\text{ cm}$ and $\angle P=25^{\circ}50'$.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Find the two possible sizes of $\angle Q$ to the nearest minute then sketch the two triangles.

answer.short: $Q=69^{\circ}02'$ or $110^{\circ}58'$. Use the sine rule, then check the supplementary angle; both triangles are possible.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\frac{\sin Q}{15}&=\frac{\sin(25^{\circ}50')}{7}\\\sin Q&=\frac{15\sin(25^{\circ}50')}{7}\\Q_1&=\sin^{-1}\!\left(\frac{15\sin(25^{\circ}50')}{7}\right)\\Q_1&\approx69^{\circ}02'\\Q_2&=180^{\circ}-Q_1\\Q_2&\approx110^{\circ}58'\end{align*}$$
Using the unrounded angles,
$$\begin{align*}P+Q_1&\approx94.8621^{\circ}<180^{\circ}\\P+Q_2&\approx136.8046^{\circ}<180^{\circ}\end{align*}$$
Both possibilities leave a positive third angle, so both triangles are valid. The sketches show the two possibilities.

spec.description: Paired unshaded triangles with common givens and acute or obtuse angle Q.
spec.mathematics: P is 25°50′, PR=q=15 cm and QR=p=7 cm. Coordinates use a common one-third scale and the unrounded corresponding values PQ=16.0062741284 cm and 10.9956882275 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Solution only; neither sketch appears in the student prompt.

children.label: b
children.prompt: For each possible size of $\angle Q$, find side length $r$ in cm. Give your answers to 1 decimal place.

answer.short: $r=16.0\text{ cm}$ when $Q\approx69^{\circ}02'$; $r=11.0\text{ cm}$ when $Q\approx110^{\circ}58'$. Use $R=180^{\circ}-P-Q$ and the sine rule.
answer.worked:
Use the unrounded values of $Q$ from part a.

For the acute value of $Q$:
$$\begin{align*}R_1&=180^{\circ}-25^{\circ}50'-Q_1\\R_1&\approx85.13788859^{\circ}\\\frac{r_1}{\sin R_1}&=\frac{7}{\sin(25^{\circ}50')}\\r_1&=\frac{7\sin R_1}{\sin(25^{\circ}50')}\\r_1&\approx16.0\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
For the obtuse value of $Q$:
$$\begin{align*}R_2&=180^{\circ}-25^{\circ}50'-Q_2\\R_2&\approx43.19544474^{\circ}\\\frac{r_2}{\sin R_2}&=\frac{7}{\sin(25^{\circ}50')}\\r_2&=\frac{7\sin R_2}{\sin(25^{\circ}50')}\\r_2&\approx11.0\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
